finding: No Snowline Diamond-only upper route is qualified in this round.
reason: The existing lift, cornice and summit decks are compulsory parts of the main path. Marking one as a route goal would grant Diamond for the normal clear. A new open-platform bypass needs a distinct jump, safe landing, visible route cue, and exact Rookie/Pro traversal proof.
candidate: An optional wind-shelf above S2's avalanche descent, entered from the cornice lip and returning before the fence checkpoint, would fit the route-goal engine's grounded rear-wheel crossing. It is a design candidate, not authored or claimed playable.

cleanSkillClocks.note: Pro's measured 45.95 s clear had two faults; no clean Pro clock qualified.

medalClock: The live rules tighten Pro medal targets by 10%; these clocks do not establish a meaningful Pro medal advantage or bike exclusivity.
